race.comment: DELIGHTFUL PEG NZ (1) has been good from wider barriers in her two outings here off a spell, winning fresh before racing three wide without cover but fighting on well as runner-up last time. She'll relish dropping to a distance where she is unbeaten in four attempts and is well served by the ace draw. FAKENIT (2) wasn't too far behind Delightful Peg when she came from a wide barrier to place last start. Led to win a G2 when resuming here prior so can take advantage of this better draw and she has won two of three previous third-up attempts. COPY CAT QUEEN (3) is first up for four-and-a-half months ago but was racing well last time in, heading to the paddock off a string of top-two results. Draws well and strikes at 50 per cent when fresh. SWEET PINS NZ (6) didn't miss by much when runner up from this barrier at his most recent appearance.
